name: Tm Headline Cards
pitch: One card per category with the latest number, its change against plan and a trend line, read at a glance.
question: How is each category doing right now, and which way is it heading?
questions: Which product lines are ahead of plan this month?
Which regions grew, and which slipped, since last period?
Is a dip this month a blip or part of a longer trend?
useWhen: Show the latest value and trend for a few categories.
audience: Managers and BI leads who need a compact status for up to 24 categories on one sheet.
features: The latest number, big and clear
Change against plan or last period
A trend line on every card
Click to filter, keys to explore

featureStrips.heading: The latest number, big and clear
featureStrips.text: Each card shows the latest value for its category in the app's own number format, so the headline reads exactly like the rest of the sheet.
featureStrips.alt: Three category cards with the latest net sales in large type, the change against plan and a trend line.

featureStrips.heading: Change against plan or last period
featureStrips.text: Add a comparison measure to show the change as a difference or a percent, in green when ahead and red when behind.
featureStrips.alt: Five category cards with the change against plan in percent, and a dash for Outdoor, whose plan is zero.

featureStrips.heading: A trend line on every card
featureStrips.text: A sparkline shows up to the latest 60 points, so a dip this month sits next to the months before it.
featureStrips.alt: Two wide cards for Accessories and Appliances with a trend line of 18 months of net sales under the headline.

featureStrips.heading: Fits any object size
featureStrips.text: On small objects the cards drop the trend line, then the change; long numbers switch to the app abbreviation.
featureStrips.alt: The same cards at three sizes: with trend lines, smaller with trend lines, and names and headlines only.

featureStrips.heading: Click to filter, keys to explore
featureStrips.text: Click a card name to select its category, or a trend point to select that category and period. Arrow keys move along the trend line.
featureStrips.alt: Five category cards with one point on the Appliances trend line ringed by keyboard focus.

hero.alt: Five cards for product categories, each with the latest net sales, the change against plan in red or green, and an 18-month trend line.
hero.caption: Net sales by category with the change against plan and the trend of the last 18 months
